children: According to CNBC, Cerebras Systems shares fell nearly 20% this week to their lowest level since the company’s May IPO after a report said Nvidia will power a key part of OpenAI’s latest model. Research firm SemiAnalysis said on X that OpenAI will use Nvidia graphics processing units, rather than Cerebras hardware, for its "Ultrafast" mode for GPT-6.1 Sol. The stock closed Friday at $166.43 and is down more than half from its initial post-IPO surge.

The decline also came as post-IPO restrictions expired on some insider shares. Cerebras closed its first day of trading with a $95 billion market cap and now has a market value of just over $39 billion. The company struck a deal with OpenAI in January worth more than $10 billion to supply 750 megawatts of computing power through 2028. According to the company’s prospectus, up to 19.4 million shares held by directors, officers, non-executive employees and other holders unlocked on Wednesday, equal to 8% of total shares outstanding.

title: Cerebras Shares Sink Nearly 20% After Report Nvidia Will Power OpenAI Model Feature
